verificationNotes: The castle hotel run under that name ('Castle Hotel Daniel 4*', opened Aug 2014) is the Daniel castle in Tălișoara/Olasztelek (Brăduț commune, COVASNA county), LMI CV-II-m-A-13271 (1669, modif. 1884), OSM way 365711775 'Dániel kastély' tourism=hotel. The family's other castle in Vârghiș itself (LMI CV-II-m-B-13316, OSM way 793420026, 46.1196/25.5628) is not a hotel and was excluded, though it is a secondary candidate. Both are in Covasna, not Harghita. Per regent-holidays, the hotel later renovated an additional building (12 rooms plus the 'Cellarium' cellar spa) a few dozen metres from the main block; the brass may belong to that phase. Footprint is the main castle block, used as the representative model. Commons category 'Daniel Castle in Vârghiș' mixes photos of both castles: 01–02 (Castle Hotel Daniel panoramas) and 03 (Tălișoara panoramio) show the Tălișoara hotel.
